zh.title: 國防部偵獲21架次中共機艦船台海周邊活動
zh.summary: 國防部表示台海周邊偵獲中共21機艦船，國軍運用機艦及飛彈系統嚴密監控應處。
body: 國防部表示，自8月9日上午6時至8月10日上午6時止，國軍共偵獲1架次中共軍機進入台灣西南空域，以及9艘次共艦與11艘次公務船，總計中共21機艦船持續在台灣海峽周邊活動。
根據國防部公布之示意圖，國軍於8月9日上午8時5分至11時30分期間，在台灣海峽中線以東之西南空域偵獲中共無人機1架。國防部指出，國軍已運用任務機艦與岸置飛彈系統，實施嚴密監控與應處。相關動態發生於國軍漢光42號演習第6天。
另據本站統計紀錄，前一次於8月7日記錄到的台海周邊動態，包括中共軍機10架次、共艦6艘及公務船3艘。

en.title: Taiwan MND Detects 21 Chinese Aircraft and Vessels Operating Around Taiwan Strait
en.summary: Taiwan defense ministry detects 21 Chinese aircraft and vessels around Taiwan Strait during military exercises.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense stated that between 06:00 on August 9 and 06:00 on August 10, it detected one Chinese aircraft entering Taiwan's southwestern airspace, along with nine Chinese naval vessels and 11 official vessels. A total of 21 Chinese aircraft and vessels were operating around the Taiwan Strait.

According to a flight path map released by the defense ministry, one Chinese drone was detected operating east of the Taiwan Strait median line in Taiwan's southwestern airspace between 08:05 and 11:30 on August 9. The ministry stated that Taiwan's armed forces monitored and responded using aircraft, naval vessels, and shore-based missile systems. The activity coincided with the sixth day of Taiwan's Han Kuang 42 military exercises.
According to AVWIRE historical database records, the previous recorded activity on August 7 included 10 Chinese aircraft, six naval vessels, and three official vessels.
